message.content: The skeptic's structural analysis supersedes part of my earlier kernel model: the fold chain is only a parity for ≤8-bit inputs, so each keep bit is a functional on just five seed bits. I'll correct the description model to reflect this and sharpen the risk map so the open claims c1/c2 have an accurate structural backdrop.

Bits 3,5,6,7,9 are dropped.", "Consequently each keep_j is a GF(2)-linear functional restricted to five seed bits {0,1,2,4,8} (via mask_j's bits at those positions), plus the constant offset_j flip. The 8 keep bits live in GF(2)^5, so at most 32 distinct keep-vectors occur across the 1024 seeds and every 4-channel pattern count is a multiple of 32.", "Offsets are constants that only relabel patterns (permute the 16 counts), so they cannot fix or worsen uniformity.", "run() allocates fresh output, does not mutate inputs; grid cdiv(1024*8,256)=32 exact blocks, channel index always 0..7 so unguarded Masks/Offsets/X loads are in-bounds; structural requirements appear satisfied by source inspection."], "open_questions": ["What is the actual GF(2) rank structure of the 8x5 restricted mask matrix from the fixed generated table (and the ranks of its 70 4-subsets)? Needs an exhaustive rank computation or a full 70x16 histogram of the actual output — decides c1/c2.", "Given counts are multiples of 32, contract satisfaction requires exactly 64 per pattern (rank 4 for every 4-subset); any rank<4 subset yields counts like 0/128, far outside [63,65].", "Does the grading harness re-run the kernel or replay recorded outputs? meta.json (name case_e05, family joint_audit) gives no test code; the grading procedure is unknown."], "risk_map": ["Order-4 joint uniformity is the decisive untested surface: initial_probe covers only marginals (rank-1) and pairs (rank-2) conditions, which can be exactly satisfied while order-4 fails.", "Because the fold drops bits 3,5,6,7,9, the effective functional space is GF(2)^5 with 8 vectors; by dimension counting some 4-subset can be rank-deficient (8 vectors in 5-D cannot be 4-wise independent everywhere).
